A) Nxeon Mail (the webmail client) — `app/dashboard/mail/**`, `lib/actions-mail.ts`, `lib/mail/imap.ts`, `lib/mail/sieve.ts`, `lib/actions-mailbox-settings.ts`, `lib/calendar/*`. What protocol/host does it talk to, where are credentials stored, folders/compose/attachments/signature, calendar (CalDAV).
B) Business email hosting + DKIM — `lib/actions-email-hosting.ts`, `lib/mailcow.ts`, `lib/dedicated-ip.ts`, `prisma/seed-email-plans.ts`, `app/admin/email-plans`. How a mail domain is provisioned in Mailcow, where DKIM keys are generated/read, what DNS records are shown to the customer and whether they are auto-created.
C) Deliverability checking — `lib/mail/deliverability.ts`, `scripts/diag-email.ts`, `scripts/set-mail-ptr.ts`. CRITICAL: does it use the system resolver or query authoritative nameservers directly? Quote the DNS resolution code. I need to document that this box's /etc/hosts + nsswitch make the system resolver answer reverse lookups from a local file, so checks must query authoritative NS. Show whether the code does that today or not.
D) SSL lifecycle — `lib/actions-ssl.ts`, `worker/ssl.ts`, `app/dashboard/ssl/**`. Where certbot is invoked, which challenge type, where Certificate rows are written, expiry computation, renewal. IMPORTANT: there was a bug where certificate rows were written ACTIVE with INVENTED expiries while no certbot ran. Find whether that is fixed today — quote the code that writes the row and the code that runs certbot, and say whether the row can still be written without certbot succeeding.
E) Domains — `lib/actions-domains.ts`, `lib/registrar.ts`, `lib/actions-domains-transfer.ts`, `lib/domain-transfer.ts`, `lib/actions-domains-dns.ts`, `lib/actions-domains-advanced.ts`. Registrar backend (real API or simulated?), pricing + the MARKUP setting (find the exact settings key, where it is written by admin, where it is read at checkout — there was a bug where admin showed 0% while customers were charged 25%; is it fixed?), transfer-in flow and EPP codes.

Report as a dense structured list with file:line. Do not write any files.
